1.

List revised.
2. Heard Sri Govind Jee Rai, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Birendra Pratap Singh,
learned counsel for the State.
3. The present transfer application under Section 407 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Hevanti Devi with the following prayers:-

"It is, therefore, Most Respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow the present criminal misc. transfer application of the applicant in Session Trial No. 980 of 2022 (State Versus Rahul and others) arising out of case Hevanti Devi vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 29 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11423374/
1 crime no. 155 of 2022 under4 section 376-D, 506 I.P.C & Section 5G/6 Pocso Act &
Section 3(2)(v) SC/ST Act, police station Bhanwar Kol District Ghazipur, pending in the court of Additional District Session/Special Judge, Pocso-1 District Ghazipur.
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to transfer the case in other district for trial otherwise the applicant is suffered from irreparable loss and injury.
And/or pass such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case."
4.
